facts.fact: 开篇连着三段单句——No.、What?、How could this man have possibly known that?——之后，Gregory 当场被问懵，回了一句 What on Wünder are you even talking about?；那个 rogue 抢着答话，说这不是殿下该操心的，只要知道他们必须现在就把她带走。
facts.anchor: No. What? How could this man have possibly known that? Gregory was visibly overwhelmed. “What on Wünder are you even talking about?” The rogue’s triumph over my capture overwhelmed his other intentions. “It’s nothing you ought to be concerned about, Your Highness. All you need to know is that we have to take her away now.”

facts.fact: 村民认出她正是他们要找的人，问 Are you sure it’s her, Tannis?；而 Tannis 正是前几天绑架过她的那伙人之一。
facts.anchor: “Are you sure it’s her, Tannis?” one of the other villagers asked. Tannis. He was one of the men who had abducted me the other day.

facts.fact: Tannis 把刀往她喉咙上又压紧，吼 All of you 退后、说再上前一步就割她；刀刃已经刮破她脖子上的皮。
facts.anchor: Tannis jerked the knife tighter against my throat. “Back off,” he barked, fear bolstered by adrenaline. “All of you. One more step and I cut her.” His hands shook, the blade scratching the skin of my neck. I didn’t imagine they planned to encounter the Wicked King in their tiny village.

facts.fact: Tannis 反手拖她、刀刮到见血；黑影先缠住他的腿和躯干把他锁在原地，随即被猛地拽开，他的刀落在正退去的一片影子地毯上。
facts.anchor: Tannis wrenched backward, the knife scraping deep enough to break skin. I cried out as he attempted to drag me with him—but black shadows had already coiled around his legs and torso, locking him in place. A sharp tug yanked him away, his knife clattering to the floor amid a carpet of shadows already receding.

facts.fact: 她的身体开始在存在与消失之间跳动：手先是血肉实体，随后苍白半透明再消失，接着轮到手臂与躯干。
facts.anchor: One heartbeat, they were solid—flesh and blood, trembling fingers dusted with powder. The next, they turned pale and translucent, the warped boards visible through them, before disappearing again. My arms followed, then my torso, my whole body phasing in and out of existence in jagged pulses.

facts.fact: 村民当众指认她就是 the general 说过的那个人，说这一切都是她干的，还说她当初穿过河边的旋涡时几乎没感觉；Tannis 嘶吼 Shut up! Let’s get out of here.，纵身跃进 anomaly 的旋涡口消失。
facts.anchor: “It is her,” one of the villagers cried out with a wild gesture of his arm toward me. “She’s the one the general was talking about. He says this is all her doing. They say she barely even felt anything when they crossed through the maelstrom at the river.” “Shut up!” Tannis hissed. “Let’s get out of here.” With a shove, he leaped into the swirling mouth of the anomaly, disappearing into thin air.

facts.fact: 原本安静打盹的村子变成战场，所有还动得动的村民都涌出来，举着斧头、棍棒、刀和工具朝他们追来。
facts.anchor: What had been a sleepy, quiet village had transformed into a war zone as every able-bodied villager had emerged. They poured out through doorways, from alleys, from behind fences and carts. Frenzied men and women charged after us with axes, sticks, blades, and tools turned into weapons. Eyes wide, my mouth dropped open. “Are they chasing us?”

facts.fact: 雪崩像一堵轰鸣的白墙压上来，吞掉小屋、篱笆和尖叫的村民；屋顶劈裂、烟囱折断，整条路径在翻涌的白雪下仿佛从未存在；雪崩以 The avalanche gained on us with terrifying ease. 的势头追上来，他们从山径最后一级跃下，而山追上了他们。
facts.anchor: The track vanished beneath our feet as we hurled ourselves downward, half running, half sliding, snow already rushing after us in a roaring white wall that swallowed cottages, fences, and screaming villagers alike. The sound was monstrous, louder than battle, louder than thought itself. I risked one glance back. The village was disappearing. Roofs splintered. Chimneys snapped. Entire paths vanished beneath churning white as if they had never existed. The avalanche gained on us with terrifying ease. We leapt the last drop off the trail just as the mountain overtook us.
